component.name: novelWriter
component.summary: Plain text editor for planning and writing novels

description.p: This is a community package of novelWriter, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream build unmodified.

novelWriter is a plain text editor designed for writing novels assembled from many smaller text documents. It uses a minimal formatting syntax inspired by Markdown, and adds a meta data syntax for comments, synopsis and cross-referencing.

ul.li: Organise a project into chapters and scenes, and plan characters, plots and locations alongside them.
Tag and reference notes from the text, and see the references in an outline view.
Track word counts and writing sessions.
Build the manuscript to Open Document, HTML, Markdown or PDF.

description.p: Projects are folders of plain text files, so they work well with version control and sync services.
Spell checking uses the dictionaries that come with the Flatpak runtime; pick one, such as en_US, in Preferences.

The package can read and write your Documents directory, which is what upstream's own Flatpak build grants; settings stay in the application's private per-app directory. To keep projects somewhere else, grant that location: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/projects io.novelwriter.novelwriter. Remove custom grants with flatpak override --user --reset io.novelwriter.novelwriter.
